comments.author: @MASMIWA
comments.text: Not mentioned is the fact that Shenzhen is a city of a thousand parks, and it now has 17 subway lines (called metros), with plans for a total of 32 lines. Along with Windows of the World theme park, it has another called Splendid China, which tries to capture China in miniature with spectacular night shows rivaling Las Vegas. Then it has another theme park called OCT, which tries to capture the beauty of European towns. Then there are  Nantou Ancient City, Dapeng Fortress, and the Chiwan Left Fort, memories of coastal defenses of the past. Shenzhen is home to many tech companies.  Famous names like Huawei, ZTE, BYD, DJI, Mindray, Tencent, Foxconn, Luxshare, Ping An, China Merchants Bank, Vanke, and BGI call Shenzhen home. And....let's not forget that Shenzhen people are from all corners of China, so the cuisine has a vast array of menus, from local Hakka and Hong Kong dim sum to Xinjiang Muslim cuisine.
